activityRules: Qualifying meaningful user activity may refresh idle timeout but must never extend the maximum session period indefinitely.
Background polling, sync and heartbeat do not count as meaningful user activity.
High-risk actions may require fresh authentication regardless of idle timeout.
Concurrent-session limit enforcement is server-side; do not silently terminate a legitimate session; offer authorized revocation or reject the new session.
Logout revokes the applicable server session; security/device events revoke applicable sessions under the approved risk policy.
refreshTokenRules: Rotate refresh tokens on successful refresh and invalidate the consumed token.
Detect consumed-token reuse; revoke the affected token family when confirmed or required by policy.
Handle concurrent refresh and network retry safely to avoid false theft detection and accidental lockout.
Never log raw access or refresh tokens.
newDeviceAndRecoveryRules: Reinstallation or changed installation ID is a new device context and cannot rely on cached identity.
Customer and Driver follow approved role-specific verification and device rules.
Admin new-device access requires approved verification and trusted-device authorization.
Super Admin device changes require separate privileged trust and protected-key enrollment/recovery.
Lost-device recovery must support authorized revocation; exact recovery procedures remain open.
stepUpRules: Password/mobile/account-security changes require fresh authentication and applicable purpose-specific verification.
Payment/wallet/refund operations require backend authorization and transaction validation plus policy-required step-up.
Driver trip-start/protected actions require the exact authorized OTP purpose when the workflow specifies it.
Admin role/permission/security configuration changes require explicit permission and fresh authentication when policy requires.
Super Admin controls require trusted-device validation and protected-key controls; fresh authentication is required when policy specifies.
A valid login/session or one OTP purpose does not grant authorization for other protected actions.
